title: Five-gene T-effector treatment-effect heterogeneity in public randomized trials of metastatic clear-cell renal-cell carcinoma
description: Public code-support repository for a manuscript evaluating a fixed five-gene T-effector score (CD8A, EOMES, PRF1, IFNG, CD274) as a candidate treatment-effect modifier across public randomized-trial datasets in metastatic clear-cell renal-cell carcinoma. This release contains code-support materials, derived non-identifying outputs, supplementary tables, audit reports, and source-data access notes. It does not redistribute raw third-party patient-level clinical-trial datasets. Code is released under the MIT License; derived documentation and tables are governed by the repository content and third-party data license notices.
